title: Background work started in a turn is killed or lost when the turn ends, the brief changes or the work is handed on

regression.report: Reports continue after v0.1.108, which shipped this fix

whatHappens: An agent starts a long capture or test in the background; at turn end or a brief update the process, its /tmp files or installed packages are gone, with no result recorded.

fixes.text: Stop repeated wakes from killing a running turn (#2892), released v0.1.108

observations.text: Feedback: 14 reports from 4 agents, 10-30 13:21 to 10-31 06:49 UTC: detached processes, /tmp evidence, command handles and installed dependencies lost across turn ends and brief updates. No fix on main.
